svg.title: CRM Craft: four task-led layout directions
svg.desc: Original schematics of a records workspace, sales pipeline, follow-up operations view, and support inbox. Synthetic example data illustrates differing page composition.

g.text: Start with the work. Then choose the composition.
Four starting points for different tasks. Compare the same screen and data when choosing a direction for a real brief.
For finding, comparing, updating and following up on accounts.
List first · saved views · quick inspection · explicit selection scope
For reviewing deal progress and choosing the next action.
Stage meaning · owner and next action · list and move alternatives
For spotting overdue work, prioritizing follow-ups and taking action.
Decision-linked metrics · scoped counts · clear ownership and next action
For moving through a queue while keeping customer context close.
The export stops after the first page.
Can you help me get the full list?
Queue + detail · customer context · reply states · deliberate send
Original layout studies · synthetic data · not product screenshots · dimensions and behavior must adapt to the brief
